summary.oneLiner: A retail-distribution-led, backward-integrating rooftop solar systems OEM whose moat is a 8,900+ channel partner network selling off-grid/hybrid backup solutions into Tier-2/3 India (necessity, not subsidy-driven), now layering on-grid + DCR cell localization to ride PM Surya Ghar / ALMM-2 — first full year post-IPO printing 72% revenue growth and margin expansion.

one-line thesis: A retail-distribution-led, backward-integrating rooftop solar systems OEM whose moat is a 8,900+ channel partner network selling off-grid/hybrid backup solutions into Tier-2/3 India (necessity, not subsidy-driven), now layering on-grid + DCR cell localization to ride PM Surya Ghar / ALMM-2 — first full year post-IPO printing 72% revenue growth and margin expansion.
financial scorecard:
| Metric | Q4 FY26 | YoY | FY26 (full year) | YoY | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | Rs 9,008 mn (~Rs 901 cr) | +87.5% | Rs 26,545 mn (~Rs 2,655 cr) | +72.3% | QoQ +53.1% vs Q3; growth ~all volume (vol up ~70%) |
| EBITDA | Rs 1,715 mn | >2x (+~109%) | Rs 4,903 mn | +97.3% | Q4 margin 19% (vs 16.5%); FY26 margin 18.5% (vs 16.1%) |
| PAT | Rs 1,063 mn | — | Rs 3,041 mn | +94.6% | Q4 PAT margin 11.8% (vs 10.7%); FY26 11.5% (vs 10.1%) |
| Material margin | — | +2.1% (Q4) | — | +1.6% (FY) | Driven by backward integration / captive mfg |
| Net D/E | — | — | 0.25x | vs 0.85x | IPO proceeds + debt repayment; gross debt Rs 4,615 mn |
| NWC days | — | — | 83 days | vs 71 days | Higher RM inventory for capacity ramp |
- **Volumes:** ~1 GW+ integrated SPGS sold in FY26; 4,00,000+ households added (inverters sold). Inverter GW sold ~2x panel GW.
- **One-offs / context:** Lower finance cost QoQ (IPO-proceeds debt repayment) aided PAT margin. Bawal lead-acid plant (1.3 GW) fire post-quarter — insured, ops suspended.
guidance (next quarter / fy27):
- **FY27 revenue: +50% YoY** guidance (mgmt says easily achievable on existing 1.5 GW + Ratlam 2 GW integrated capacity).
- **FY27 quarterly shape (mgmt indicative, Rs cr):** Q1 ~900, Q2 ~800, Q3 ~800, Q4 ~1,500 (seasonality — Q4 strongest).
- **PAT margin FY27: 11%–13%** (deliberately sharing DCR margins with channel to acquire customers); EBITDA margin "sustain to improve" from ~18.5%.
- Ratlam: ~50% utilization in FY27, ~80% by Q4 FY28, peak revenue ~Rs 5,000 cr when fully utilized (target Q4 FY28).
order book & pipeline:
- No formal order book (retail/distribution model; revenue cycle ~14 days from distributors).
- Demand "pipeline" = ~7 mn untapped installs under PM Surya Ghar ≈ ~25 GW incremental opportunity; China adds ~60 GW rooftop/yr as TAM proxy.
- Channel: 8,900+ partners (added 80+ distributors, 450+ dealers, 30 exclusive Shoppe outlets in Q4). Target to double channel partners over ~3 years via twin-brand strategy.
segment / subsidiary:
- Revenue mix (Q4, mgmt approximate): ~40% solar panels / ~40% power electronics / ~20% battery (fluctuates by geography & power-cut conditions).
- Geography: core Tier-2/3 + towns/villages (UP best state, still growing); newly focused Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Assam; south demand skews on-grid/hybrid, east (Assam/WB) hybrid + off-grid.
- Plants: Noida (integrated, largest contributor), Dadri (#2; cell + 1.2 GW panel line), Ratlam (new 2 GW integrated), Bawal (lead-acid — fire-hit, suspended).
growth verticals / optionality:
- **DCR / ALMM-2 play:** 1,000 MW Mono PERC cell + planned 1,200 MW TOPCon cell at Ratlam → addresses on-grid rooftop under ALMM-2 (mandatory DCR cells for grid-connected); margin (not revenue) accretive since backward integration.
- **On-grid expansion** under PM Surya Ghar (historically off-grid-led) — new TAM, Tier-1 entry.
- **Proprietary products:** "Sigma" hybrid solar PCU (claims exclusivity); developing residential & industrial BESS systems for future demand.
- **Twin-brand strategy** to roughly double channel reach.
- **AI cost-out:** mapping service & sales processes with AI to compress opex.
margins & cost dynamics:
- FY26 EBITDA margin 18.5% (+240bps); driven by material-margin gains from captive cells/batteries/electronics + operating leverage + employee-cost optimization.
- DCR cells carry higher margins but mgmt deliberately passes part to channel to win customers; non-DCR margins softening; net stance "stable to improve."
- Bawal third-party sourcing (lead-acid) → marginal margin drag, offset by top-line; spare lead-acid capacity widely available as market shifts to Li-ion.
capex / expansion:
- Ratlam 2,000 MW integrated (panels commissioned; **inverter line → Q1 CY27**, **battery line → Q2 CY27** — delayed by geopolitics & shift to 300 AH Li-ion cell tech).
- **TOPCon 1,200 MW cell line — Rs 350 cr capex** (all-inclusive ex-land; land already owned in Ratlam Phase-1/2). Board approved; order to be placed (quotations finalized).
- FY26 capacity ramp: solar panels 1,039→1,639 MW; power electronics 1,143→2,180 MW; Li battery 45→545 MWh.
- Existing new line at ~65% utilization, ramping to ~80% in 1-2 months; overall segments run 70-80% (Li-ion catching up).
capital allocation:
- IPO proceeds used to repay debt → net D/E 0.85x → 0.25x. No promoter stake sale or fresh raise planned in next 12 months.
- Capex self-fundable given low leverage and ~Rs 304 cr FY26 PAT; RM inventory build is the main working-capital draw.
risks & watch-items:
- **BIS seizures:** 10-15 of ~500 SKUs (inverters/batteries) under BIS question; max penalty = seizure value; mgmt expects no material penalty, no impact on PM Surya Ghar eligibility or Dadri/Ratlam ramp.
- **Bawal fire:** 1.3 GW lead-acid plant suspended, cause under investigation; insured; relying on third-party supply — execution/insurance-claim risk.
- **Margin transparency:** refuses segment-wise volume/revenue disclosure (competitive reasons) — limits modeling visibility.
- **Inventory bloat:** NWC 71→83 days; ~Rs 500 cr+ of ~Rs 900 cr inventory is RM; mgmt says normalizes once Ratlam ramps.
- Rising competition (many entrants into rooftop) and ground-mounted price competition; non-DCR margin pressure + inflation.
- Execution risk on delayed inverter/battery commissioning (slipped to CY27).
management quality / tone: - Confident, candid on operational detail (utilization, mix, BIS, fire) but guarded on segment economics. Articulate strategy: necessity-led off-grid demand, distribution relationship moat ("agreements are paper, it is relationship — 15-25 yr distributors"). Conservative-leaning guidance (50% revenue, 11-13% PAT). Some over-promotion on "proprietary"/AI themes; first full year as listed entity — execution credibility still being established.
non-obvious takeaways:
- Backward integration (cells) lifts margin, NOT revenue — TOPCon/Mono cell GW does not add top line. Revenue growth must come from system volumes.
- Inverter GW sold ~2x panel GW, yet panels are the bigger revenue/inventory line (higher Rs/watt) — explains the RM inventory spike skewed to panels.
- DCR margin upside is being deliberately competed away to grow channel — the model optimizes customer/distributor acquisition over headline margin.
- Demand is "necessity/backup" (grid instability) rather than subsidy/ROI — structurally less policy-sensitive than pure on-grid peers, a differentiator.
- Mgmt explicitly trades top-line vs margin based on capacity availability — expect margin to firm when capacity-constrained, dilute when capacity is ample (Ratlam ramp).
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary stock(s) | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| ALMM-2 mandating DCR solar cells for grid-connected systems | UTLSOLAR · 544613 (self) — adding 1,000 MW PERC + 1,200 MW TOPCon cell | Importers of finished modules / non-integrated rooftop assemblers reliant on Chinese cells | Captive DCR cell lifts material margin & ensures compliance/availability. High conviction (self). |
| ~25 GW untapped PM Surya Ghar rooftop TAM, on-grid push | UTLSOLAR · 544613 (self) — entering on-grid + Tier-1 via hybrid | — | Large incremental volume runway; mgmt 50% FY27 growth. Med-High. |
| Tier-2/3 distribution & service hard to replicate | UTLSOLAR · 544613 (self) — 8,900+ partners, decades-old relationships | New rooftop entrants without ground service network | Service-reference-driven buying favors incumbents. Med-High (self). |
| Lead-acid → lithium-ion battery transition | UTLSOLAR · 544613 (self) — Li capacity 45→545 MWh, planning BESS | Pure lead-acid battery makers; e.g. Amara Raja (code unverified), Exide Industries (code unverified) | Demand migrating to Li-ion / BESS; UTL building Li + BESS optionality. Med. |
| Rooftop solar competitive intensity / capacity additions FY27 | Larger integrated rooftop peers, e.g. Waaree Energies (code unverified), Premier Energies (code unverified) | Sub-scale assemblers facing price competition | Scale + integration + brand win; ground-mounted price war less relevant to UTL's rooftop mix. Low-Med (external, unverified). |
qoq change log:
- Revenue Q4 FY26 Rs 901 cr vs Q3 FY26 ~Rs 588 cr (+53.1% QoQ); March alone ~Rs 400 cr (peak-utilization month).
- EBITDA +56% QoQ; PAT +58% QoQ; PAT margin 11.4% (Q3) → 11.8% (Q4), aided by lower finance cost (IPO debt repayment), partly offset by higher other opex.
- Ratlam 2 GW panel line commissioned (will contribute from Q1 FY27, not Q4). New events this quarter: Bawal fire (post-quarter, plant suspended); BIS seizure of 10-15 SKUs flagged; TOPCon 1.2 GW Rs 350 cr line board-approved.
- New FY27 guidance introduced: +50% revenue, 11-13% PAT margin, Ratlam full utilization by Q4 FY28.

themes.title: Solar PV cell-to-module manufacturing
themes.need: Solar module/cell manufacturers ride capacity ramp, ALMM/DCR protection and an order-book build-out - a manufacturing thesis distinct from firm-power/FDRE tender economics or merchant storage arbitrage. Q1FY27 quantified the DCR arbitrage: EMMVEE grew revenue 51% to INR 1,555cr with EBITDA margin up to 35.2% and PAT +103% on a 9.9 GW order book, with DCR modules earning INR 8.5-9/W of EBITDA against INR 2-2.5/W for non-DCR - a 3-4x per-watt gap that structurally separates integrated cell makers from module assemblers. The offset is order timing: SWSOLAR booked a record INR 13,000cr unexecuted order value on a landmark USD 560m Egypt win (1,000 MW solar + 600 MWh BESS) yet revenue still fell 10% YoY, and flagged that industry orders concluded only ~INR 6,400cr against the >INR 20,000cr expected, deferred by DCR/module-price uncertainty.
themes.driver: DCR cell/module capacity commissioning and the ALMM List-2 per-watt spread; domestic ordering restarting after two slow quarters (SWSOLAR); order-book conversion.
